We don’t do hair. But we do straighten out some of the world’s biggest challenges.

Our Location Intelligence team utilises Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and a range of spatial and non-spatial data to enable our clients to understand relationships between data, undertake analytics and visualisations, and transform data into actionable insights. Alternatively, you could be studying towards a degree in Engineering or Computer Science, with a passion for GIS.
* Has an interest in working in consulting and the engineering and environment sectors
* has good verbal and written communication skills.
* is enthusiastic and willing to learn across a wide range of projects.

We have positions are available in several of our GHD offices, commencing in February 2027:

* Melbourne
* Adelaide

* Hobart

**A frizz-free application process:**

We want your journey to be as smooth as possible, so here’s everything you need to help you prep like a pro:

* **Your CV:** This gives us a snapshot of what you’ve studied and your experiences, both paid and unpaid.
* **A cover letter:** Think of this as your chance to show us where you’d love to grow within GHD, while letting your communication skills shine.
* **Your transcript:** This helps us understand what you’ve been learning, from your core subjects to the electives that sparked your curiosity.
  

**Your journey to joining GHD:**

Here’s what to expect, step by step:

* **Screening:** We review applications as they come in, but be mindful that the bulk of our screening happens after applications close, so don’t worry if you don’t hear from us right away.
* **Virtual Assessments:** If you make it through the first stage, you’ll record some answers to a few straightforward questions and complete some cognitive games. This helps us get a better sense of your work style and alignment to GHD Graduate roles.
* **Meet the team:** If you’re successful, you’ll have a face-to-face interview (wherever possible) with your prospective team. We’ll chat through some *behavioural based questions* to learn more about your skills and experience. It’s also a chance for you to get to know us!
* **Offer:** Congratulations! We’ll talk through all the finer details, like salary, your start date, our onboarding process and what to expect before your first day.

We’re committed to being as inclusive as possible and giving everyone an equitable chance of getting through our application process. **If you identify as someone who is neurodiverse or have a disability** and need adjustments to any part of the process, let us know in your application form—we’re here to help.

  

**Start dates and opportunities**

Most of our full-time roles kick off in February 2027, though there may be the possibility of earlier start dates for some teams. Plus, there might also be casual work opportunities throughout your final year of study to give you a head start.

  

**Ready to shine?**

If you’ve got your documents polished and prepped, the application should only take 10-15 minutes. Apply now and take the first step toward an exciting career in consulting.

  

**GHD: The Power of Commitment**

At GHD, we don’t just believe in the power of commitment, we live and breathe it every day.
  
  
Community impact is important to us, influencing how we work, our projects and how we give back. Our *GHD in the Community* program partners with not-for-profit organisations so that we can work on pro-bono projects, as well as volunteering and fundraising for philanthropic and humanitarian causes. As a business, we also channel some of our profits into the *GHD Foundation* *,* a registered charity that addresses disadvantage and inequality in children accessing STEAM education in the countries where we live and work.

Within GHD, our employee groups and networks help us foster community, find our tribe, and celebrate what makes us unique. These groups play a big part in our global diversity, equity and inclusion strategy, creating spaces for meaningful and safe conversations, connecting with likeminded individuals, and creating a voice to leadership.

**Job Description**

**What is the opportunity?**

RBC is growing in Australia and is looking for a candidate to add to the Australian Equity Research team based in Sydney or Melbourne. We are looking for a suitably qualified candidate with an avid interest in financial markets. Candidates will be responsible for fundamental analysis of Australian companies operating across the Global Industrials sectors.

RBC provides investment research to institutional fund managers in Australia and offshore. Companies covered vary from established large cap businesses to emerging small cap companies. Associate roles primarily provide research support to Lead Analysts. As you develop, your career pathway includes assuming lead coverage of some companies in your own right depending on your experience and track record of performance in the role.

**What will you do?**

* Understand what companies under coverage do, how they do it, and the market environment in which they operate.
* To understand and be able to build and update company financial models in Microsoft Excel.
* Understand how the company’s profit and loss, balance sheet and cashflow statements interrelate and be able to build and link the core items of these financial statements in Microsoft Excel.
* Be able to update historical company financials from available public data sources.
* Understand the key drivers of a company’s earnings profile and be able to forecast future earnings estimates.
* Understand how to value a company using different valuation methods e.g. DCF valuation methodology, comparable company and multiples analysis.
* Generate high quality research reports and presentations.
* Build and maintain databases of key industry data points.
* Support the Lead Analyst to promptly respond to institutional client queries.
* Identify key operational and earnings risks of companies under research coverage e.g. competitor, ESG, macro, commodity price, geopolitical etc.
* Establish key industry contacts to assist in forming a comprehensive view of the company and the operating environment.

**What do you need to succeed?**

**Must-have**

* Strong interest in equity markets and finance.
* Willingness to learn and analyse industry sectors and companies.
* Undergraduate degree with a focus on Business, Commerce, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science or similar field.
* Minimum 2-3 years’ full-time work experience, preferably in an equity research role or corporate finance role at a bank, stockbroking firm, investment fund or accounting firm.
* Excellent writing and communications skills with the ability to interact with the CEO, CFO and IR personnel of the companies under coverage.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong skills across Microsoft Office applications – primarily Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
* Ability to source data and concisely summarise information from multiple sources e.g. online databases, government statistics, journals, trade publications etc.
* Ability to work independently and under pressure in a high paced environment.
* Flexibility to travel when required.

**Nice-to-have**

* CFA qualification, or
* An accounting qualification, or
* Relevant post-grad qualification.
* Work experience in industrial companies and/or sectors.
* FactSet or Bloomberg experience.

We thrive on the challenge to be our best - progressive thinking to keep growing and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

* Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive and high-performing team.
